title: Hyundai Engineering & Construction
summary: Korean construction group that builds nuclear plants and large infrastructure.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Hyundai Engineering & Construction builds nuclear power plants, oil and gas facilities, and infrastructure, and is part of the Korean consortium that exports APR-1400 reactors. Its nuclear experience is a differentiator in emerging-market bids. Construction margins and overseas awards drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Nuclear plant construction
  • Oil, gas and industrial facilities
  • Infrastructure and housing

What To Watch

  • Overseas nuclear awards
  • Construction margins
  • Middle East and Asia project demand

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
